public_api.note: Release 0.4.0a1 introduces LOT-18 Subledger Foundations on top of stable 0.3.0: entity-scoped subledgers and parties, auxiliary references, receivables/payables with due schedules, OpenItem projections distinct from JournalEntryLine, explicit posted-accounting links, versioned auxiliary policies and fail-closed control-account resolution through the applicable company-chart version. Settlement, allocation, matching, aging and subledger reconciliation remain LOT-19+ scope. The public Python API remains intentionally unfrozen before 1.0.
